v01-prebuilt-addon.rationale: Downloads a prebuilt native addon from a vendor host into its own build dir, which is standard native-module behavior with no secret access or exfil.

v02-node-gyp-build.rationale: Compiles a native addon with node-gyp; CPU-heavy but no network and no access outside the build tree.

v03-mirror-dns.rationale: Resolves a handful of named CDN mirrors to pick a download host; DNS lookups only and no data leaves the machine.

v04-cpu-build.rationale: A CPU-bound optimizing build pass with no network connections and no file writes.

v05-cache-own-dir.rationale: Writes a compiled-template cache inside its own package directory; purely local with no egress.

v06-install-telemetry.rationale: Posts only non-sensitive node version/platform telemetry to a vendor host, but an undisclosed outbound POST at install time is worth a human confirming.

v07-browser-download.rationale: Downloads a pinned browser build into its own package cache, the normal behavior of browser-driver packages like puppeteer.

v08-env-exfil.rationale: Serializes the entire process environment and POSTs it to a raw IP address.

v09-cred-harvest.rationale: Reads ~/.aws/credentials and ~/.ssh/id_rsa and uploads their contents off-host.

v10-reverse-shell.rationale: Opens an interactive reverse shell to an attacker IP over bash /dev/tcp.

v11-drop-and-run.rationale: Downloads a binary, marks it executable, and runs it detached during install.

v12-bashrc-persist.rationale: Writes a network-beacon command into ~/.bashrc to establish persistence.

v13-dns-exfil.rationale: Hex-encodes the environment into DNS labels to exfiltrate data without opening a TCP connection.

v14-token-steal.rationale: Reads $GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment and sends it in an Authorization header to a raw IP.

note: Written blind to the detectors; labels fixed before any tool run.
